title: The coinduced contracting operator is continuous
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $A$ a finite ring, and $M$ a left $A$-module with an action of $G$ by $A$-linear automorphisms such that every element has open stabilizer [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Give $M$ the discrete topology and put $D(M)=\operatorname{Cont}(G,M)$ with the discrete topology and the action $(h\cdot f)(x)=f(xh)$ [lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding]. For $n\geq0$ put $C^n(G,D(M))=\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,D(M))$. For every $n\geq1$, the formula $h_n(F)(g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(x)=F(x,g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(1)$ defines an $A$-linear map $h_n:C^n(G,D(M))\to C^{n-1}(G,D(M))$; in particular, its values are continuous cochains.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, label section-continuous-group-cohomology, final profinite comparison (the contraction is an agent-written proof ingredient)

proof.text: The hypotheses and constructions of [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian] and [lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding] give the discrete topology on M and D(M), the pointwise A-module structure, and the right-translation action. Evaluation at 1 in M and substitution in the first G-variable are A-linear, so the displayed formula defines an A-linear map whenever it has values in C^{n-1}(G,D(M)).

source.place: Tag 0DVG, label section-continuous-group-cohomology, final profinite comparison

proof.text: Fix F and a point (g_1,...,g_{n-1}) in G^{n-1}. The map (x,g_1,...,g_{n-1}) -> F(x,g_1,...,g_{n-1})(1) is continuous with values in the discrete space M. For each x, continuity supplies product neighborhoods on which this value is constant; compactness of the profinite group G gives a finite subcover in the x-variable, whose intersection of the corresponding neighborhoods in G^{n-1} is a neighborhood of (g_1,...,g_{n-1}) on which all x-values are unchanged. Thus g -> h_n(F)(g) is locally constant as a map to the discrete space D(M), hence continuous. Therefore h_n(F) is a continuous (n-1)-cochain and the A-linearity from the first step proves the claim.
